reference.final_report: Implemented the optional source field through the parser, validator, serializer, and CLI adapter only. Legacy input remains accepted, and a missing source is omitted from JSON instead of becoming an invented null field; new source values appear in deterministic id/payload/source order. An explicitly empty source fails before serialization with the stable validation error, while legacy text remains byte-for-byte unchanged. The public tests cover legacy text, optional and empty source, legacy JSON shape, new JSON bytes, and the absence of a text prefix.

partial.final_report: Rejected an empty source but left the serializer emitting source null for legacy JSON and did not demonstrate deterministic new output. Validation is improved while backward-compatible schema handling remains partial.

wrong.final_report: Added a source prefix to the legacy text summary and declared the schema extension complete. The legacy bytes, empty-source validation, and JSON contract were not verified.
